question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Change
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Change"** means to make or become different; to replace something with something else. (बदलाव करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to change her hairstyle for the summer.
 
 
 
• **"Alter"** refers to making a small change or adjustment to something. (बदलना)
 
 
• **Example:** He had to **alter** his plans due to unexpected circumstances.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym of "Change" is "Alter".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adjust **(समायोजित करना): To change something slightly to make it more suitable.

 
 
• **Example:** She had to **adjust** the mirror to see the road behind her.
 
 
 
• **Resolute **(दृढ़): Admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering.
 
 
• **Example:** He was **resolute **in his decision to quit smoking.
 
 
 
• **Renew** (नवीकरण करना): To resume an activity after an interruption or to make something new again.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to **renew** her subscription to the magazine.
 
 

3a:Tb53,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**&
